newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian dollar, bonds little moved on GDP data.
newsitem.headline: Australian dollar, bonds little moved on GDP data.

text.p: The Australian dollar and debt futures were little changed immediately after the Australian Bureau of Statistics said that March quarter GDP rose 0.9 percent, taking the annual growth rate to 2.4 percent.
This compared with median market forecasts of an 0.8 percent rise and a 2.2 percent annual rate.

The dollar was at US$0.7611/16 compared with US$0.7609/14 just before the data, while the June 10-year bond futures contract was at 92.680 against a pre-data 92.690. September bills moved to 92.64 from 92.66.
